changelog:
Initial release of memories-cli — the command-line utility for managing persistent memory for AI agents.

- Adds CLI reference and documentation for installation, initialization, and integration with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and more).
- Provides quick command reference for adding, searching, editing, and managing memories.
- Documents core workflows: new project setup, rule ingestion, searching, config generation, cloud sync, embeddings, and maintenance.
- Describes memory types, project/global scopes, and advanced features (templates, links, tags, git hooks, import/export).
- Includes links to comprehensive command and workflow references.
